verdict.rationale: OpenTofu is a scriptable CLI. Saved plans can be applied later non-interactively (`plan -out` then `tofu apply`), and speculative plans fit code-review pipelines, so it can serve as a building block for unattended automation. Nothing in the evidence shows native scheduling, background execution, or autonomous runs; those would need external tooling such as CI systems. missing for 10: built-in scheduled or background runs, an autonomous agent or daemon mode, documented unattended automation (e.g., drift detection) workflows, independent corroboration.
